This small piece of land is just a corner of my farm where I plant my yam with some maize and vegetables in between. The soil here has been tired over the years, so I will put a little fertilizer along with the manure from my goats — yam responds well when you feed the mounds. I keep my own seed yams from last harvest because the improved ones are hard to find at the agro-dealer and cost too much for me. The work of making the mounds is heavy, so I will call one or two young men from the village to help me for a couple of days, but most of the planting and weeding I will do myself with my family.
